description: This Java class defines the CollectChargesCommandStrategy which implements the CommandStrategy interface to handle batch requests for collecting charges on a loan. It interacts with the LoanChargesApiResource to retrieve all charges for a specific loan identified by the path parameters in the request URL, and constructs a BatchResponse containing the result.

classes.name: CollectChargesCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements CommandStrategy interface to handle batch requests that collect charges for a specific loan by interacting with LoanChargesApiResource and returning a BatchResponse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to collect all charges for a specified loan. Extracts the loanId from the URL, invokes the LoanChargesApiResource for retrieving charges, and constructs a BatchResponse with the results.
